title: Lens grammar correction response
description: The object the model is asked to return inside choices[0].message.content on the grammar channel. One sentence in, the corrected sentence out. The sentence is not echoed back as a title: the app already holds it.

results.description: Exactly one entry: the whole message is one item.

corrected.description: The whole sentence with its mistakes corrected, or unchanged when it was already correct.
